article.story: MACOMB, Ill. -- — Kjay Bradley Jr. had 25 points in Cal State Bakersfield’s 91-83 victory against Western Illinois on Thursday. Bryce Cofield scored 19 points and added three blocks for the Roadrunners (3-0). Tom Koppens had 13 points and shot 4 of 6 from the field and 5 for 6 from the free-throw line. Danny Stephens finished with 21 points for the Leathernecks (1-3). Makai Kvamme added 16 points for Western Illinois. Daivion Traylor finished with 15 points and eight rebounds. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
